app.name: DClaw Offboard
app.description: AI-powered offboarding platform that automates compliance, protects company assets, and preserves institutional knowledge — all while treating departing employees with dignity.

hero.headline: Intelligent Offboarding for the Modern Enterprise
hero.subheadline: Detect risks before they escalate, automate compliance, orchestrate integrations, and protect your IP — all with AI-powered workflows.

featureTiers.label: Core Platform
featureTiers.description: Foundation features required for every offboarding — shipped and production-ready.

featureTiers.label: AI-Powered Intelligence
featureTiers.description: Advanced AI capabilities that automate analysis, capture knowledge, and connect your entire SaaS stack.

featureTiers.label: Enterprise Analytics
featureTiers.description: Deep compliance automation, predictive analytics, and team continuity planning.

features.title: AI Offboard Copilot
features.description: An intelligent assistant that guides managers and employees through compliant, compassionate offboarding. Get instant answers on final pay, benefits, references, and policies.
bullets: RAG-powered answers on final pay, benefits & references
Personalized by employee role, tenure, and department
Available 24/7 via floating chat widget in the portal
Reduces HR ticket volume by up to 40%

features.title: Smart Offboarding Checklists
features.description: Auto-generated checklists tailored to department and role. Track IT, HR, finance, legal, and manager tasks with dependencies and real-time progress.
bullets: Role-aware auto-generation based on department and seniority
IT, HR, finance, legal & manager task tracks in parallel
Task dependencies, deadline enforcement & owner assignment
Asset recovery integrated as a task type — no separate flow

features.title: Access Revocation Automation
features.description: One-click revocation of system access across your entire SaaS stack. Full audit trail and compliance logs for every revocation event.
bullets: One-click revocation across 50+ integrated systems
Revoke email, Slack, GitHub, VPN & building access simultaneously
Tamper-proof audit trail for GDPR, SOC2 & EEOC compliance
Native Okta, Azure AD & Google Workspace connectors

features.title: Risk Assessment & IP Protection
features.description: AI anomaly detection flags suspicious activity 30–90 days before departure. Monitor file access, downloads, and email forwarding to protect company IP.
bullets: AI anomaly detection on file access, downloads & email forwarding
30/60/90-day pre-departure monitoring windows
Automatic forensic evidence preservation with chain of custody
Risk scoring (low / medium / high / critical) per employee

features.title: AI Exit Interview Analysis
features.description: Schedule and conduct exit interviews with AI transcription and sentiment analysis. Extract themes, identify retention trends, and generate actionable leadership insights.
bullets: Async or live interview scheduling with automated reminders
AI transcription + sentiment scoring (positive / neutral / negative)
Automatic theme clustering and trend detection across cohorts
Retention insight reports delivered to leadership dashboards

features.title: AI Knowledge Capture
features.description: Real-time AI extraction from meetings, chats, and documents. Auto-generate structured handover docs and validate completeness — no manual forms required.
bullets: AI extraction from meetings, Slack threads & documents
Structured handover document generation with gap detection
Completeness validation before final offboarding sign-off
Auto-populates the company knowledge base for future hires

features.title: Integration Hub
features.description: API-first connectors for HRIS, SSO, Payroll, MDM, and Communication tools. Orchestrate offboarding across your entire SaaS stack with webhooks and real-time sync.
bullets: Pre-built connectors: Workday, BambooHR, Okta, ADP, Jamf, Slack
Webhook engine for custom integration with any internal system
Integration health dashboard with real-time sync status
One-click offboarding orchestration across all connected apps

features.title: Alumni Network & Rehire
features.description: Maintain positive relationships with former employees. Track rehire eligibility, send anniversary check-ins, and build a boomerang hire talent pipeline.
bullets: Alumni CRM with rehire eligibility flags and notes
Automated anniversary check-ins and engagement sequences
Boomerang hire pipeline integrated with your ATS
Referral campaign tools leveraging the alumni network

features.title: Payroll Integration Hub
features.description: Connect directly to ADP, Gusto, QuickBooks, and more. Pull real-time salary, PTO balance, and tax data to auto-calculate final pay in seconds.
bullets: Live sync with ADP, Gusto, QuickBooks & Xero payroll APIs
Auto-calculates final pay including unused PTO & severance
State and federal tax table compliance built in
Eliminates manual entry errors that cause compliance gaps

features.title: Compliance Automation
features.description: Auto-generate EEOC, GDPR, CCPA, SOC2 reports with AI validation. Enforce data retention policies, track non-competes, and maintain audit-ready documentation.
bullets: One-click generation of EEOC, OSHA, GDPR, CCPA & SOC2 reports
AI validation checks report completeness before submission
Automated data deletion schedules per retention policy
Non-compete & NDA tracking with expiration alerts

features.title: Sentiment & Early Warning
features.description: Anonymous pulse surveys and AI sentiment analysis detect flight risk before the resignation letter arrives. Proactive retention recommendations based on behavioral signals.
bullets: Anonymous pulse surveys measuring engagement & burnout
AI sentiment trend analysis across teams and departments
Flight risk prediction model using behavioral signals
Retention recommendation engine with personalized interventions

features.title: Team Transition & Coverage
features.description: Auto-reassign direct reports, transfer calendars, identify coverage gaps, and manage temporary assignments — ensuring zero disruption during departures.
bullets: Auto-reassignment of direct reports to new managers
Calendar and recurring meeting transfer with one click
Coverage gap detection for critical responsibilities
Temporary assignment tracking with expiration dates

steps.title: Detect & Assess
steps.description: AI monitors for early warning signals. Once offboarding is triggered, risk assessment analyzes data access patterns and flags anomalies.

steps.title: Orchestrate & Execute
steps.description: Integration Hub orchestrates checklist creation, access revocation, and asset recovery across 50+ connected systems in minutes.

steps.title: Capture & Transition
steps.description: AI captures institutional knowledge in real-time. Team transition tools ensure seamless coverage with zero disruption.

steps.title: Learn & Comply
steps.description: AI-analyzed exit interviews reveal retention insights. Automated compliance reports satisfy EEOC, GDPR, SOC2 requirements.

testimonials.quote: The risk assessment caught a departing engineer downloading our entire codebase. We were able to preserve evidence and take action within hours.
testimonials.author: Sarah Chen

testimonials.quote: Integration Hub cut our offboarding from 3 weeks to 3 hours. One-click revocation across 50+ systems is a game changer for compliance.
testimonials.author: Marcus Rivera
